cards.back: One interaction: a call, chat, task, or email. A transfer usually creates another contact linked by PreviousContactId and NextContactId.
The Connect container in one Region. It holds users, flows, queues, and numbers. A new account starts at two instances per Region.
The visual program a contact runs. The JSON form is the flow language.
A published, reusable piece of a flow. Invoke module runs it. Return ends it. Default quota is 200 modules.
A string key and value stored on the contact. Lambda, Lex, and Set contact attributes write them. Screen pop reads them.
The interruptible flow that runs while the customer waits, before an agent joins.
Audio played to one party immediately before the customer and agent are joined.
The queue selected by Set working queue. Transfer to queue uses it.
The list of queues an agent can receive, with channel concurrency, priority, and delay.
A number on a queue inside a routing profile. A lower number is served first.
Seconds a contact must wait before an agent with that profile can receive it.
Ordered steps that tighten or relax who can take the contact. The successor idea to precision-queue steps.
A level on a predefined attribute for an agent. Default quota is 10 proficiencies per agent.
Where a contact waits. Standard queues hold customers. Agent queues hold transfers to a specific user, 10 contacts each by default.
The weekly schedule and time zone attached to a queue. Check hours of operation reads it. Overrides cover holidays.
A one-click transfer target: a user, a queue, or an external number.
A direct inward dial number. In the US it is carried by one carrier and priced per day plus per minute.
A number the caller does not pay long-distance to dial. US toll-free numbers are registered with SOMOS and can use more than one carrier.
Universal International Freephone number. One of the four number types Connect sells, with DID, toll-free, and shared cost.
Moving a number from another carrier onto Connect. The quota page points you at the same Support form used for quota increases.
Contact Control Panel. The browser phone and contact UI the agent uses.
The fuller desktop around the CCP: profiles, cases, step-by-step views, and third-party apps.
The amazon-connect-streams library. It embeds or replaces the CCP and listens to agent and contact events.
The WebRTC audio path. It needs outbound UDP 3478 to the Regional TurnNlb domain.
The relay used when the browser cannot send media directly. The error text names turn:TurnNlb-....elb.region.amazonaws.com:3478.
The bot service Get customer input calls. Connect stores intent and slots on the contact.
What Lex thinks the caller wants. The flow branches on it.
A value Lex fills, such as an order id. The flow copies it into an attribute.
The 4 Aug 2026 name for the feature previously called Amazon Q in Connect, which itself included Wisdom.
The 2023 name for generative assistance. The admin guide renamed it agent assist on 4 Aug 2026. IAM still shows the wisdom prefix.
The 2020 preview name for agent search and recommendations. Folded into Amazon Q in Connect on 28 Nov 2023.
Associates an AI agents domain with the contact so recommendations can run.
A block that hands the contact to an Agentic CX Designer application and routes on the exit condition.
The 4 Aug 2026 name for Voice+. Priced at 0.01 USD per minute on top of the channel. Trial through 30 Nov 2026 is not billed.
The 4 Aug 2026 name for Contact Lens: transcripts, sentiment, redaction, summaries, and categories.
The former name of conversational analytics. The product page says the function remains.
Rules on a live contact, announced 1 Dec 2020. Default quota is 300 concurrent real-time analytics calls.
A generated summary after the contact. Preview 28 Nov 2023, generally available 25 Mar 2024.
A quality scorecard. Preview 29 Nov 2022, generally available 26 Apr 2023. Now part of performance evaluations.
Contact trace record. The JSON document for a finished contact, streamed to Kinesis or Firehose.
Near real-time Kinesis stream of login, logout, status, and contact join. This is the WFM adherence feed.
A CloudWatch log of each block. Set logging behavior turns it on. The log group is under the instance.
At most 8 seconds. The function's own timeout can be longer. The flow still takes the Error or Timeout branch at 8 seconds.
The flow continues without waiting. You can wait up to 60 seconds with a Wait block. A sequence of Lambda calls must finish within 20 seconds.
A flat object of string keys and string values. One of the two Lambda response shapes.
The profile store. Connect-generated profiles are priced differently from profiles that contain imported data.
The rules that merge profile records from CRM, orders, and contacts into one customer.
A durable issue that can span many contacts. Cases became generally available on 3 Oct 2022.
A unit of work with no live media. Default concurrent quota is 2500. Tasks can be scheduled up to 90 days ahead.
What a user may do in the admin site and the CCP. Different from an IAM policy.
What an AWS principal may call. Connect, Profiles, Cases, and agent assist use different IAM prefixes.
The role AWS creates so Connect can write to S3, CloudWatch, and other services you name.
The key's own allow list. Recordings stay unreadable if the key does not trust the Connect role.
The federated sign-in option. The assertion must carry the routing profile, security profile, and role.
A common identity provider in front of Connect. It still speaks SAML to the instance.
The supported multi-Region design. Pairs are us-east-1 with us-west-2, eu-central-1 with eu-west-2, and ap-northeast-1 with ap-northeast-3.
The object that splits telephony and agent sign-in across the two Regions in 10 percent steps.
The linked instance created by ReplicateInstance. Flows, users, queues, and profiles are copied. S3 prompts are not.
The name used from 28 Apr 2026 for the contact center product previously called Amazon Connect.
The form of the product that does not include every Connect Customer feature. Voice on this form is listed at 0.018 USD per minute plus telephony.
Caller authentication and a fraudster watchlist. New customers stopped 20 May 2025. Support ended 20 May 2026.
Proactive voice, SMS, or email. The name replaced high-volume outbound communications on 20 Jun 2022. Voice minutes are 0.045 USD on Connect Customer.
The block that branches on answering-machine detection. Campaign flows only.
A chat that can go quiet without holding a concurrent-chat slot the way an abandoned idle chat does.
A third-party messaging channel counted inside the concurrent chat quota. Connect Customer prices the message at 0.014 USD before delivery fees.
Replies within 90 days stay on the same thread. Later replies start a new one.
Rows the Data Table block can read or write inside a flow. Defaults: 100 tables, 5 primary attributes, 1000 values.
Renders a step-by-step view in the agent workspace.
Invokes a tool through an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway.
Sends live customer audio to Kinesis Video Streams for a third-party recorder or bot.
Records the agent desktop. On the Basic price list it is 0.006 USD per minute.
The 4 Aug 2026 name for native WFM: forecast, capacity, schedules, and adherence.
How closely an agent's actual status matched the published schedule. Native metrics appear after schedules are published. Third-party WFM reads agent events.
The fraction of paid time that is not handling contacts. Erlang staffing divides raw agents by one minus shrinkage.
The share of contacts answered inside a target wait. Queue.Duration on the CTR is the usual clock.
Handle time plus ACW, divided by signed-in time that was available for work. Agent events supply the clocks.
After contact work. The agent is still busy after the customer leaves. It counts in occupancy and in the concurrent task and email quotas.
US enhanced 911. For a US agent, Connect can send a validated civic address with a direct 911 call from the CCP.
The test number that reads back the originating number and the address. Use it instead of a real 911 test. A non-emergency 911 call is described as a 100 USD penalty.
The contact attribute that carries the E911 address as a JSON string. Keys include country, A1, A3, HNO, RD, STS, and PC.
The Amazon Chime API that checks an address against the Master Street Address Guide before you store it.
A managed package plus a serverless app that embeds the CCP in Salesforce.
Salesforce Contact Center with Amazon Connect. Voice stays on Connect. Messaging can be Connect or Salesforce.
The ServiceNow integration that imports flows, maps queues to Advanced Work Assignment, and can attach AI voice agents.
A published pattern: a Teams app, Azure Bot Service, API Gateway, Lambda, and StartChatContact. It is chat, not a phone trunk.
Analytics on audio that stays on another platform. The appendix lists 0.032 USD per minute and 100 USD per connector per day.
Metrics and flow logs. Alarm at 80 percent of a quota, which is the operations guidance in the email quota note.
The durable stream for CTRs and agent events when more than one consumer must read them.
The delivery path into S3. It buffers. Silence for five minutes is the point to check the error prefix.
Live audio for third-party recorders. Start media streaming opens it. Customer and agent audio are separate tracks.
The bus for contact events if you want a rule, not a stream consumer.
The WAV Connect writes when recording is on. Third-party QM tools often import this object plus the CTR.
The unit of traffic. One Erlang is one hour of call time in one hour. Calls per hour times AHT in hours.
The probability a contact waits when there are N agents and A Erlangs, assuming infinite queue and random arrivals.
Average handle time. Talk plus hold plus ACW, unless your report defines it more narrowly. Say which one you used.
The only Regions Global Resiliency links. Osaka is a replica Region for Tokyo, and inbound delivery there can take up to 20 seconds.
Domains instead of the whole EC2 and CloudFront IP ranges. Recommended. Test more than 200 calls. An error rate above 2 percent means the proxy may be the problem.
Must allow the browser's ephemeral UDP range back in, or media fails even when 3478 is allowed outbound.
The current instance domain. awsapps.com is the old domain the docs say is going away.
Default 10 active PSTN and WebRTC calls. This is the first capacity gate on a new instance.
Small raises can be hours. Large ones can take up to three weeks. A worldwide raise can take months.
The foundational AWS Certification. It covers the shared vocabulary of accounts, Regions, and billing. It is not a Connect exam.
The associate exam that best matches the AWS services a Connect design uses.
A Skill Builder and Credly badge. Pass mark is 80 percent. It is not an AWS Certification exam.
The networking specialty exam. Last day to take it is 31 December 2026.
CUCM's list of partitions a phone may dial. The Connect cousin is a routing profile, and they do not configure each other.
A UCCX contact service queue. Map it to a Connect queue, not to a routing profile.
A UCCE queue with attribute steps. Map the steps to routing criteria, not to one flat skill group.
The Cisco agent desktop. The Connect cousins are the CCP, the agent workspace, and a Streams application.
Cisco Unified Intelligence Center. The Connect cousins are real-time metrics, historical metrics, and the CTR.
An Avaya vector directory number. Map it to a phone number plus the flow that number starts.
CUCM's dial-plan bucket. Connect has no partitions. Numbers are claimed, ported, or reached with Transfer to phone number.
AWS runs the Region, the softphone service, and the multi-tenant platform. You run flows, IAM, keys, numbers, quotas, and the agent network.
One JSON step. Types are contact, participant, interaction, or flow control.
The path a block takes when it fails. An unconnected error branch ends the contact.
Opening the customer record when the contact arrives. Connect does this with attributes, Profiles, and a workspace app. It is not a CTI cable.
The account-level service that attaches data and event integrations. Default is 20 data integrations per Region.
A supported place to attach the next system: a stream, an event, a block, or a workspace view. Build on a hook instead of scraping the CCP.
The one-page picture of which system owns telephony, the agent, the record, the score, and the emergency call.
Scoring contacts against a form, coaching from the score, and keeping the recording that proves it.
Removing sensitive data from a transcript or recording. Conversational analytics can redact. Confirm the rule before you promise a regulator it is on.
A rules match on words, sentiment, or silence. Supervisors subscribe to categories. They are not intents.
A rest-of-day volume prediction. Native forecasting updates it every 15 minutes.
How many agents you need for a service level, a handle time, and a shrinkage assumption.
The constraint native scheduling uses when an agent requests leave. It is not the same object as hours of operation.
The caller ID sent with an outbound or 911 call. Responders can call it back only if that number accepts inbound calls.
The address database ValidateE911Address checks. A free-typed address is not enough.
The task the 911 whisper flow creates so security or HR knows a 911 call was placed.
Keeping the old platform and Connect both able to receive the number while you compare flows, reports, and failover.
The tested path back to the old platform or the other Region. A port without a rollback date is not a plan.
Reads real-time queue and agent metrics into attributes so a flow can branch on them.
Offers a contact to a named agent even if that agent is at maximum concurrency or in a custom status.
Lets the caller type ahead. Set Touchtone Buffer Behavior controls it.
Sends a share of contacts down each branch. Use it for a measured pilot, not for skills.
Zero-ETL contact data that Athena or QuickSight can query. Previewed 28 Nov 2023.
The metrics API you want for new dashboards. It is the current metrics call, as opposed to the older GetMetricData.
Interval reports: 15 minutes, 30 minutes, daily, or total. They are not the real-time board.
The live agent, queue, and routing-profile board. It is eventually consistent. Do not use it as a per-call audit.
A stack resource whose content is flow-language JSON. Use it to move a flow between instances.
Attaches a Lex V2 alias to the instance. The flow still has to select that alias.
A policy on the resource, such as Lambda, that allows connect.amazonaws.com to invoke it. An identity policy on a user is not enough.
The practical ceiling called out for a Lambda payload Connect will consume. Larger or nested payloads take the error branch when the block expects a string map.
A number Connect hosts. The default quota is 10 per instance, and the first claim can still fail until Support clears it.
A number type where the caller pays a local share. Sold per day, like DID, toll-free, and UIFN.
Voice from a web or mobile widget. Audio is an extra 0.010 USD per minute on top of the voice service charge.
0.015 USD per minute per participant in the appendix, plus the voice charge. Video calling does not support VDI.
Counted in the concurrent chat quota with SMS and WhatsApp.
Default quota is 0. Until you raise it, campaign calls hear a fast busy.
Up to five levels of groups for reporting lines. The quota is 500 groups across all levels.
Available, offline, or a custom status. The quota is 50 statuses and it is not adjustable.
How long ACW may last. Per-channel auto-accept and ACW timeouts were called out in the February 2026 document history.
A view that tells the agent the next click. Previewed in the workspace on 29 Nov 2022.
The content agent assist searches. Default quota is 10 knowledge bases and 5000 content items each.
The control that keeps a generated answer inside the knowledge you provided. If you cannot show the source article, do not treat the answer as a fact.
The Lex intent used when nothing else matches. Point it at a person, not at a loop.
Keypad tones. Get customer input and Store customer input read them. Lex can also consume them.
Markup for text-to-speech. Set voice chooses the language and voice the prompt uses.
A stored audio file or a TTS string. Default quota is 500 prompts.
Runs after the contact ends. Use it for surveys. Do not use it to keep the caller on the line.
What the customer hears on hold. Loop prompts is the usual block.
Set callback number, then a queue callback, so the caller does not wait on the phone. The queue still needs agents.
A contact that waits without an open media leg, then Connect dials the customer when an agent is free.
Sends the contact to the PSTN. This is how Connect reaches a CUCM route point or a Teams Phone number.
CUCM or Webex keeps enterprise extensions. Connect keeps the public contact center number. They meet by transfer, not by a shared dial plan.
A competing Cisco CCaaS. It is not a connector you install under Connect. During a move you dual-run numbers.
The Genesys flow tool. Map each Architect task to a Connect block. Map in-queue audio to a customer queue flow.
The Avaya step list. Announcements become Play prompt. Route-to becomes a transfer. Collect becomes Get customer input.
The S3 policy that lets the Connect role put objects. A private bucket with no policy produces a silent missing recording.
A third-party recorder in another account needs the stream ARN from the contact event and an IAM role that can read the stream.
Agent events in, schedule from WFM. The comparison is the adherence number. Without the stream, the WFM tool only has history.
A Kinesis capacity slice. One shard is a common starting point for agent events and is too small when a second consumer appears.
The key that ties the flow log, the CTR, the recording, the agent event, and the CRM activity. Lose it and the ecosystem cannot be audited.
A supported extension point you can adopt later without rewriting the flow: EventBridge, streams, views, data tables, or External Tool.
The name on the 22 Jun 2026 preview of Agentic CX designer. Generally available 2 Sep 2026.
The speech model named in the 30 Nov 2025 agentic self-service announcement.
A preview assistant for supervisors asking operational questions in natural language. Announced in preview 10 Mar 2026.
As of the 28 Apr 2026 AWS News Blog, the Amazon Connect family is Customer, Health, Decisions, and Talent. This campus teaches Customer.
The other three solutions in the family. They are not settings inside a contact center instance.
A price you computed from the public rate card on a named date. It is not an invoice. Taxes, surcharges, and country telephony rates still apply.
